name: smokeping
title: SmokePing
description: SmokePing pings a list of hosts every few minutes and draws latency and packet loss over time, which shows when a connection is unstable and since when. The graphs are at /smokeping/ on its port. After deploying, put your own hosts (router, ISP gateway, DNS servers) in App-Data/SmokePing/config/Targets and restart.

variables.name: PORT_SMOKEPING
variables.label: Web port
variables.description: Host port of the web page (the graphs are under /smokeping/)
